records.text: And then one of you guys sent me over a tip and reminded me that the original American Patsy, of course, Lee Harvey Oswald, when the public began having questions about his involvement, did he really shoot JFK (John F. Kennedy)? Our CIA engaged in Operation Mockingbird, right?
